knobs.note: BH-3422: 0 stops the lane before any vendor fetch (summary ` disabled`). Read by bin/model-watch.sh as ${MODEL_WATCH_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/model-watch.notes.log and the default.

BH-3422: comma list of watched vendors. Each name is its own OpenRouter id prefix (anthropic, x-ai); lowercased and trimmed, and a name outside [a-z0-9-] is dropped with a note. Only anthropic has a probe runner and a vendor list of its own (with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Read by bin/model-watch.sh as ${MODEL_WATCH_VENDORS:-anthropic}.

BH-3422: USD cap on the one liveness probe per new anthropic model, read where it is spent: bin/lib/model-watch-suggest.sh mw_probe_run, ${MODEL_WATCH_PROBE_USD_CAP:-1}. 0 = `probe disabled`, nothing spent. A run spends at most MODEL_WATCH_MAX_NEW x this.

BH-3422: new models announced (and probed) per run, oldest first_seen first; the rest are counted `deferred` and drain next run. Read by bin/model-watch.sh as ${MODEL_WATCH_MAX_NEW:-5}; outside 1..20 is one warn line and the default, never a clamp.
BH-3422: an OpenRouter list with fewer entries than this is an outage (one warn `model-watch-fetch`, nothing recorded), not `nothing new`. Read by bin/model-watch.sh as ${MODEL_WATCH_MIN_LIST:-5}.
Test seam: a file bin/model-watch.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.
Test seam gate: bin/model-watch.sh sources MODEL_WATCH_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
